name: GEOX — Earth Intelligence
description: Governed geoscience coprocessor under arifOS constitutional floors F1-F13. Evidence-only earth intelligence: basin analysis, seismic interpretation, petrophysics, prospect evaluation, deep-time paleogeography, temporal intelligence, and 9 interactive MCP Apps. Live counts under static-client auth: 19 governed tools, 16 MCP prompts, 51 MCP resources (9 of which are ui:// MCP Apps). Canonical registry: 81 tools registered; 62 are forge-scope or internal-only and filtered per oauth.scopes_excluded.

oauth.how_to_configure: In your MCP connector UI (Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cloudflare Workers AI, etc.), set: (1) Endpoint URL = https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp, (2) Custom HTTP header X-MCP-Client-Id = geox-claude-conn-20260804-a01. Connector should send this header on every MCP request. Caddy edge validates the header before arifOS forward_auth — valid ID bypasses forward_auth and routes directly to GEOX :8081.
oauth.authorization_servers_status: P3_DRAFT — full OAuth AS not yet deployed. Use static client_id until P4.
oauth.deprecation: When auth.arif-fazil.com/realms/arifos reaches P4_STABLE, static client_ids enter 30-day deprecation grace. Migrate to OAuth 2.1 + DPoP.
oauth.trigger_event: 2026-08-04 — Claude.ai MCP connector error: 'Automatic client registration isn't supported' (ref ofid_ca10349aa319689a).

tools.publicCountRationale: Live tools/list returns 19 governed tools for clients with scopes [geox:observe, geox:interpret]. The static client_id `geox-claude-conn-20260804-a01` excludes geox:forge scope per oauth.scopes_excluded. The remaining 62 (totalRegistered 81 - publicCount 19) are forge-scope or internal-only tools, not exposed to MCP tools/list under static-client auth. Migration to OAuth 2.1 (P4_STABLE) will surface scoped counts per session.
